payload.rebuttal: fixed: Rewrote every expected LeftOut in the three tests that construct one (unknown-state, unknown-risk, and the edited-shapes witness) to use keyword arguments (task_id=..., spec_id=..., reason=...) instead of positional ones, and added explicit attribute assertions on the unknown-risk witness. A dataclass's generated equality compares same-named attributes regardless of declared field order, so a keyword-built expected value is bound correctly even when the class's field order is swapped, while the production code's positional construction is not. I verified this by re-applying the exact edit from the finding and confirming all three tests now fail on it.
